title: Limits of action minimization: collisions, constraints, stability, and fixed energy
exact_target: Determine the scope of celestial-mechanics minimization methods across symmetries, topology, masses, stability and fixed-energy constraints.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002552 (AIM-PHYSICS-0060). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 23.

status_qualification: All five programme questions are retained. A coercivity certificate in one symmetry class or a local stability statement does not settle the entire methodological target. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
